title: Complete a strict recursive data contract validator
instruction: Complete validate as a strict recursive validator without changing its API. Support type values integer, number, boolean, string, null, array, object, and a non-empty list representing a union. Python booleans must not satisfy integer or number. Arrays require an items schema. Objects validate declared properties recursively, enforce a required string-key list, allow undeclared keys by default, and reject them only when additionalProperties is false. Malformed or unsupported schemas return false rather than raising. Add regression tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: V2 screening lineage for recursive contract coverage and Python scalar edge semantics.
